goal.original: Continue MPI-620: ship the Scribble flow - draw on a blank canvas, a model renders it.
goal.summary: The flow is BUILT AND WORKING. Fabio ran it live several times: two clean blank-canvas generations (one with an Anime style LoRA), a 4B run, and a run seeded from an uploaded sketch. The pivot to edit models is done end to end - FlowDef, both graphs, the test. What remains is polish and two specified-but-unbuilt follow-ups, not the flow itself.

completed: FlowDef pivoted: both ControlNet fields deleted, slot is klein-9b (recommended) + klein-4b with loras:true, modelParams per tier, hint rewritten.

flow_draw_it_in.json gained the 6-slot user LoRA rack (Fabio's call, so both flows benefit) - MpiLoraModel nodes deep-copied from character_sheet's Phase2 rack, spliced into the single MODEL link. Its FlowDef slot now carries loras:true. Stays 9B-only.
flow_scribble.json rebuilt as a Klein edit graph derived from Draw It In: 11 photo-insertion nodes removed, two seams rewired, prefix + guardrails + save prefix rewritten. 41 -> 30 nodes.
Both graphs verified with scripts/verify-workflow.mjs against the engine on 48188 and scripts/validate-injection-rules.mjs.
The flow_scribble case in tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs rewritten to the edit-model shape, incl. a walk of the LoRA rack chain and negative assertions that no ControlNet apparatus survives.
BUG: clearing a filled media slot broke navigation (sparse-array hole + Array.find). Fixed, reproduced before and after in an isolated instance.
BUG: clearing a slot also deleted the step's declared field values, silently discarding a typed prompt. Fixed to preserve `fields`.
`blankOnly` step-field flag added: canvas size is disabled when the slot is filled instead of live-but-inert.
npm test 737/738, npm run test:desktop 28/28 (two new specs), eslint clean. Committed and pushed as f1880430.

/mpi-flow-graphics for the tile + hero, then add the preview/video keys in the SAME commit as the art files.
Then /mpi-end-session - the flow itself is finished and green.

task_card.title: Scribble Flow - draw on a blank canvas, SDXL + ControlNet renders it

next_action.description: Read the brief's '## OPEN FOLLOW-UPS' section and build follow-up 1 (reuse opens the flow with a toast instead of redirecting to the Flow Library) together with follow-up 2 (record flowModelIds at dispatch) - they pair, because the substitution toast has to name the tier it is substituting. Both touch files MPI-620 does not own yet, so extend files.json first. Do NOT re-verify the flow itself: it is built, live-tested by Fabio, and both suites are green.

key_decisions: EDIT MODELS ONLY, klein-9b + klein-4b, nothing else. Krea 2 rendered drawn pink dashes as real pink road paint through three prompt reframings (its Krea2EditModelPatch ships ref_boost 2, never tested at 1.0). Boogu passed but lost on quality AND speed (38-39s vs Klein 14-27s) and would have forced a second sampler chain into the graph, because a flow op resolves as a UNIVERSAL workflow - ONE file, resolved before any model lookup.

The baked prefix is settled and two properties are load-bearing: it says REPLACE (not 'change the drawing', which licenses keeping part of one - that is what left strokes in the output), and it names NO output medium (an earlier 'photorealistic photograph' version worked but would have made anime unreachable from a baked prefix). Verified both with a style LoRA and with the style typed in.
No `style` select field, deliberately - a style LoRA already does it better. That same run upgraded `loras: true` from assumption to measurement.

Draw It In got the rack on Fabio's explicit call, overruling its FlowDef's earlier no-rack decision. That decision's hazard is real and unchanged (a style LoRA restyles the whole photograph, not just the inserted subject) but the rack is opt-in. Draw It In stays 9B-only; 4B's exclusion there rests on separate live evidence.

Card display of flow models: record ALL slots, display only when flowModelChoices(flow).length === 1. Fabio's objection is why - a four-stage flow has four models and they cannot live in a two-row corner label.
constraints: The bench-editing doc's serialiser recipe is WRONG for these raw files and would turn a six-node change into a whole-file diff. It says CRLF + no trailing newline + ensure_ascii=True. Measured: LF, WITH a trailing newline, ensure_ascii=FALSE. flow_scribble round-trips clean under the doc's recipe only because it happens to be pure ASCII. Fix that doc at close-out.

tests/orphan-sweep.test.cjs 'collects a dep no installed model wants' FAILS on this machine and it is NOT this card's doing. CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT only controls where the fixture writes and where the sweep deletes; _localSharedDepsMap stats the REAL models root, so installing Boogu made the fixture's 'orphan' genuinely wanted. CI stays green because the runner has no models installed. Do not chase it as a regression.
sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while a generated workflow is uncommitted, and it AUTO-COMMITS the raw source itself. Commit the generated pair before the next sync rather than fighting it.

MpiBaseFlow cannot be measured in a detached div and the shell's flow:open path gives a 0x0 overlay with no project open. Mount into a throwaway div, then append inst.el into a position:fixed;inset:0 host - a display:flex host shrinks the whole flow to content.

`seeded` prefers state.s_flowInputs[flow.id] over props.initialInputs, so a media-seeded mount leaks into the next probe and makes a blank case read as filled. Clear state.s_flowInputs on BOTH sides of any multi-mount flow probe - this produced one confident wrong measurement.

Kill an isolated app instance ONLY by its renderer's --user-data-dir (cubric-agent-profile). Fabio's live app is the byte-identical 'electron.exe .' and an age or name filter has killed his session before.
